$description: Layout tokens: the structural decisions that are neither colour, type, space nor motion.
idConvention: Token ids are dotted, lower-case, tier-prefix-free. Foundation ids are <category>.<name> (color.mainbg-dark, type.h1, spacing.1, radius.md, breakpoint.tablet, elevation.z-header, icon-size.header-logo, motion.transition.fast). Semantic ids are <role>.<variant> (text.primary, surface.page, border.hairline, accent.primary). Component ids start with component.<name>.<slot>, layout ids with layout.<name>. A "$ref" is always another token id.

layout.page.shell.note: section.page - the wrapper that holds header, menu, page content and footer. It is a WRAPPER, not a content section, so it has no section contract.

layout.tech.padding-top.note: 8rem on section.tech, the only top offset on the four tech routes.

layout.dots-field.width.note: 52 columns x 1rem + 51 gaps x 1rem = 103rem exactly, which is why 103rem appears 8 times in the stylesheet. It is NOT a content max-width: its other 7 uses are all .hero__404__* layers.

layout.dots-field.grid.note: Rebuilt in JS by public/motion/m07.js; ROWS is always 14, so 728 / 336 / 308 dots.

layout.hero.slider-axis.$value: vertical (--ty-end: -100%) at min-width 992px, horizontal (--tx-end: -100%) at max-width 991px
layout.hero.slider-axis.note: The only min-width:992px query in the project.

layout.menu.panel-closed.note: The closed menu panel ships as inline style on .menu__wrap and as a head <style> override.

layout.step-slide.viewport.$value: perspective 250vw on .list__main__content__wrap; .list__main__content is position absolute inset 0
layout.step-slide.viewport.note: The original ships `transform-style: preserve-3d` with NO semicolon before `transform-origin: 50% 10%`, so browsers discard BOTH declarations. They are kept commented out in src/styles/fourmula-head.css:150-159 to match real rendering. DO NOT 'FIX' THIS.

layout.trusted-marquee.row.$value: two identical 11-item rows, each animated 24s linear infinite translateX 0 -> -100%
layout.trusted-marquee.row.note: The duplication is what makes the marquee seamless.

layout.how-column.loop.$value: two identical 3-item columns, each animated 24s linear infinite translateY 0 -> -100%
